name: HubSpot
tagline: CRM, marketing, sales, tickets, and automation APIs.
shortDescription: HubSpot exposes CRM objects, associations, owners, tickets, forms, webhooks, workflows, and app auth APIs.
agentSummary: Agents can read and update customer records, deals, tickets, and marketing data when scopes are configured carefully.
bestFor: CRM sync, lead enrichment, ticket operations, customer data, and sales workflows.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Customer data, email sending, and CRM writes require scoped apps and human approval. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public product pricing but feature/API limits vary by hub and plan.
authModel: Private app tokens, OAuth apps, CRM scopes, and HubSpot MCP OAuth credentials.
accountCreation: Self-serve CRM signup; app setup requires developer configuration.
browserSupport: Browser UI is important for schema, permissions, and workflow review.

capabilities.detail: CRM APIs cover contacts, companies, deals, tickets, associations, and custom objects.
HubSpot's remote MCP server lets compatible clients query HubSpot CRM data using OAuth-controlled app scopes.
Developer docs include API reference, guides, scopes, and webhooks.
Product pricing is public, but API access and limits depend on hubs and plan.
Self-serve CRM signup; app setup requires developer configuration.
Browser UI is important for schema, permissions, and workflow review.
